query_text: Create a ranked bar chart of the top 10 companies by `Mosaic momentum`, defined as the one-year Mosaic change divided by `Founded age in years`, using only companies with numeric Mosaic change and numeric Founded year, with values shown as `Mosaic-change points per company-year`.
selection_rule: top 10 companies with numeric Founded year and 1-year Mosaic delta

plot_config.title: Top companies by age-normalized Mosaic momentum

reasoning_summary: Filtered to companies with numeric founded year and one-year Mosaic change.
Computed company age as 2026 minus Founded year.
Divided Mosaic delta by age in years and ranked descending.
